effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: a strip of flat 2D blades along the bottom of the view, swaying in a wave of wind, one instanced draw through the HDR tail, over the page. Every later effect starts from this shape.

scorecard.fallback: A row of SVG blades, or the poster.

effects.title: Fur text
effects.summary: A heading grown over with fur, grass or moss: strands drawn by shells from the letters’ distance field and lit as strands, which the pointer combs over and which slowly stand back up.

scorecard.fallback: The heading in a warm brown with a soft text shadow, or the poster.
useCases: A playful or tactile hero heading
A pet, textile or outdoor brand

effects.title: Grass on the page
effects.summary: Grass growing along the top edges of the page’s own headings, cards and buttons, and along the bottom of the view: it sprouts unevenly and fills in over time or as the page scrolls, sways in a wave of wind, and parts around the pointer.

scorecard.fallback: A CSS strip of grass along each element’s top edge, or nothing.
useCases: A spring or seasonal landing page
A garden centre or sustainability site

effects.title: Grass footer
effects.summary: A strip of grass along the bottom of the page, seen from just above the ground: blades placed, clumped, bent by gusts and culled in compute each frame, then drawn with indirect draws. The pointer parts it.

scorecard.fallback: A row of SVG blades swaying with CSS transforms, or the poster.
useCases: A spring or outdoor landing page

effects.title: Grass growth
effects.summary: A lawn growing in from bare ground as the page scrolls, or over time: patches sprout at their own moments and spread until they meet, each blade rising to its height. It shrinks back the same way.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: patches of lawn coming up through bare soil.
useCases: A "growth" story on a landing page

effects.title: Lawn
effects.summary: A lawn seen from standing height. The pointer brushes a trail through it and a press treads it down; the grass rises back over a few seconds, without bouncing, to exactly upright. A cursor trail with a memory.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: a still of the lawn.
useCases: A garden, landscaping or outdoor-brand section

effects.title: Meadow
effects.summary: A meadow at eye level running to the horizon: tall grass with seed heads and wildflowers, coloured from leaf pigments and lit through the blades when the sun is behind them; gusts and cloud shadows crossing it, pollen in the light, the nearest blades out of focus. The pointer brushes a path that springs back.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: a still of the meadow, or a photograph.
useCases: An outdoor or travel brand hero
A landing page for spring or summer

effects.title: Mowing
effects.summary: A lawn being mown in stripes. The mower cuts the grass and lays it the way it travels; the stripes appear because grass laid away from you shows its lit upper side and grass laid towards you its shaded one. Drag to mow; left alone, it mows by a progress value, as a progress bar.

useCases: A playful progress bar or loader

effects.title: A flower opening
effects.summary: One flower opening from the bud, over time or as the page scrolls: a lily, buttercup, cherry blossom, poppy, rose or camellia, built from its floral diagram, its petals grown surfaces that ruffle where their edges grew more.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: the flower half open.
